property_summary: For all callers a and any key k, calling XBornID() on the correct contract only ever sets the owner's balance to totalDistributed (i.e. balances(owner) == totalDistributed and balances(a) == previous balances(a)), whereas the mutant allows a non-owner caller to set their own balance to totalDistributed, so there exists a caller a for which balances(a) == totalDistributed after calling XBornID(), violating the invariant that only owner gains totalDistributed.
change_summary: Replaced owner-only require check with no check and assign totalDistributed to caller (msg.sender) instead of owner, so calling XBornID sets balances[msg.sender] = totalDistributed rather than balances[owner].
